text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, listen to this, Kaicho! Tsuru-chan 
puts vinegar on her fried eggs!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, fried eggs with vinegar are 
delicious, though! And it's good for your 
health, too! The power of vinegar is 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, tastes vary from person to person. 
It seems like a very sensible choice, 
quite fitting for Tsuyoshi, who is so 
mindful of health.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I get that, but still! Fried eggs 
definitely go best with soy sauce, don't 
they?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I think demi-glace sauce is number 
one! Though the fried egg that comes with 
the hamburger steak might actually be my 
absolute favorite!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Calculating preferences from flavor 
pairings— such free-spirited thinking is 
so like Teio. It's a perspective I never 
would have thought of."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Then what's the President's preference!? 
Ah, wait! Let me guess!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hhhnnnggg...! Got it! Is it chuno sauce?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, close, but not quite. The correct 
answer is Worcestershire sauce. 
Specifically, one rich in apple juice. It 
coats the mild flavor of the egg 
beautifully, making for a delicious taste.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! You like sour things too, President!? 
Just like me! Yay, yay~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Then I'll eat it like that too! 
Fried eggs with Worcestershire sauce, just 
like the Prexy!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then for our next lunch, the three 
of us shall enjoy sunny-side up eggs 
together.
